versions.content: Ethernet IEEE1722Tp Stream support Description: The System Template shall support the modeling of streams according to IEEE Std 1722-2016 [4] Rationale: Configuration of streams, the stream providers, and stream consumers. Use Case: Define the existence of IEEE1722Tp streams and who is producing and consuming the streams. Provide information about each stream content such that bandwith calculations are supported.
